# third_party

Downloaded dependencies of the MuJoCo simulation of the Panda. Nothing here is needed to build the library or run
the unit tests; only the optional MuJoCo build (`-DSE3PF_WITH_MUJOCO=ON`) and the Python tools use it. Everything
in this directory except this README is generated by `tools/fetch_mujoco.sh` and is not committed (`.gitignore`).

## Contents

| Path | What | Source and pin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mujoco-3.15.0/` | MuJoCo C library, release build for Linux x86_64: `include/mujoco/*.h`, `lib/libmujoco.so.3.15.0`, tools in `bin/` (`simulate` is the interactive viewer), samples in `sample/` (about 90 MB) | [github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/releases/tag/3.15.0](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/releases/tag/3.15.0), tarball `mujoco-3.15.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, sha256 `319943b332fd84c968f655f695d8f4b03cc6a68f658bacd0591f0a552744e497` (checked against the release's own `.sha256` file and against the pin in the script) |
| `mujoco_menagerie/franka_emika_panda/` | MuJoCo Menagerie model of the Franka Emika Panda (FER): `panda_nohand.xml` (arm only, 7 joints), `panda.xml` (with the Franka Hand, 9 joints), `scene.xml` (`panda.xml` plus floor, sky and lights), `mjx_*.xml` (MJX variants, not used), meshes in `assets/` | sparse, shallow clone of [github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie) at commit `0059d4335f8156206f63a35662313385f7ad6d74` (main on 2026-10-07; the Panda directory last changed in `71f066a`, 2026-07-04). Cone mode also checks out the files at the repository root (README, LICENSE, ...) (about 43 MB with the git data) |

Which model to use:

- `panda_nohand.xml` for verifying the controller: `nq = nv = nu = 7`, no equality constraints or tendons, and joint
  `i` is driven by actuator `i`. The Menagerie link frames `link1` to `link7` are exactly the modified-DH frames of the
  design doc, and the flange (Franka frame F) is `link7` translated by 0.107 m along its z-axis.
- `scene.xml` (or `panda.xml`) only for pictures and videos: the hand adds two finger joints, a tendon, an equality
  constraint and 0.76 kg at the flange.

Checks that use these files:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build-rel -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DSE3PF_WITH_MUJOCO=ON && cmake --build build-rel -j
./build-rel/mujoco_smoke third_party/mujoco_menagerie/franka_emika_panda/panda_nohand.xml   # C API, torque mode
MUJOCO_GL=egl .venv/bin/python tools/mujoco_model_check.py --png out/rest.png               # DH vs MuJoCo, render
```

## Licenses

- MuJoCo: Apache License 2.0, `mujoco-3.15.0/LICENSE`; the libraries bundled into `libmujoco.so` are listed with
  their licenses in `mujoco-3.15.0/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`.
- Menagerie Panda model: Apache License 2.0, `mujoco_menagerie/franka_emika_panda/LICENSE` (the repository root
  `LICENSE` collects the licenses of all models; the section for `franka_emika_panda/` is the same Apache-2.0 text).
  The model is derived from Franka Emika's `franka_description` (franka_ros); see its `README.md`.

## Fetch again or upgrade

```bash
bash tools/fetch_mujoco.sh                      # into third_party/ of the project (the default)
bash tools/fetch_mujoco.sh /some/other/dir      # anywhere else
```

The script is idempotent: a complete MuJoCo directory and a Menagerie checkout at the pinned commit are kept. To
upgrade, change `MUJOCO_VERSION`, `MUJOCO_SHA256_PINNED` and `MENAGERIE_COMMIT` at the top of the script (or override
them for one run, e.g. `MUJOCO_VERSION=3.16.0 bash tools/fetch_mujoco.sh`), and install the same version of the
Python package (below). CMake picks up `third_party/mujoco-*` by itself; `-DMUJOCO_DIR=/path/to/mujoco-<version>`
selects a specific one.

## Python environment (`../.venv`)

The Python package `mujoco` must have the same version as the C library, so that a model and its numbers agree
between the two. Created with the default `python3` (miniconda's Python 3.13.5):

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -r tools/requirements-mujoco.txt   # mujoco==3.15.0, numpy, matplotlib, imageio(-ffmpeg), Pillow
```

Off-screen rendering (`mujoco.Renderer`) works with `MUJOCO_GL=egl` (NVIDIA EGL, no window) and with
`MUJOCO_GL=glfw` (needs the X display); `MUJOCO_GL=osmesa` does not work here (no OSMesa library installed).
Use `MUJOCO_GL=egl` for scripts and videos (`imageio` with `imageio-ffmpeg` writes H.264 MP4).
